cirrhosis_medical_equipment_devices.real_working_solution: Real working solution: ultrasound-guided paracentesis for ascites drainage/diagnosis, fluoroscopy-guided covered-stent TIPS for refractory ascites/variceal bleeding, and endoscopic multi-band ligator devices for variceal banding -- all real, standard, widely-available interventional tools.

effectiveness_ranked_table.caveat: These are real, differently-defined outcome metrics (overall transplant survival %, histological fibrosis-regression %, abstinence survival-ratio, relative-risk/hazard-ratio reductions, and single-arm response rates) placed on one comparative scale for consistency with this project's other entries -- they are NOT equivalent statistics and a lower rank does NOT mean a lower-ranked real intervention is medically less important or interchangeable with a higher-ranked one (e.g. antibiotic prophylaxis's 21% relative mortality reduction in acute variceal bleeding is a real, mandatory, life-saving intervention despite ranking below transplant survival, which is measuring a completely different, later-stage outcome). Liver transplantation and early etiology-directed treatment/fibrosis regression are honestly identified as the strongest real disease-COURSE-altering options (they change the trajectory of the disease itself); everything else below them is real, effective, standard-of-care COMPLICATION management (they treat consequences of the disease without altering the underlying fibrosis/cirrhosis).
